title: Multi-Plan Household Bundle Rate for Optional Coverage Add-Ons Premium Corrections
content:
Households that hold other Bridgewell plans carry a bundle rate on their Optional Coverage Add-Ons riders. A corrected bundle rate is added to the corrected discount rate used for a rider's premium billing correction, according to the customer's holdings of two other plans in active status:

- a plan of the Utility Line Protection Plans, and
- an agreement of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements.

| Utility Line Protection Plans plan in active status | HVAC Maintenance Agreements agreement in active status | Corrected bundle rate added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.06 (6 percent) |
| Yes | No | 0.03 (3 percent) |
| No | Yes | 0.03 (3 percent) |
| No | No | None |

A plan or agreement counts only while its status is active; one that is cancelled, expired or in any other status is not held for this rate.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A customer holds an active Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan and an active Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard agreement: 0.06 is added.
- A customer holds an active HVAC maintenance agreement and a utility line plan that has been cancelled: only one of the two is held in active status, and 0.03 is added.
